content:
kevin: Heads up — I'm rolling subnet/NAT/PrivateLink changes to prod next week. Need quick review on TF diffs and migration plan.

sarah: Can you paste the plan? especially route table associations and AZ mappings.

kevin: pasted plan output:
```terraform
# aws_route_table_association.main will be created
+ resource "aws_route_table_association" "main" {
+   subnet_id     = "subnet-..."
+   route_table_id= "rtb-..."
+ }
# aws_nat_gateway.mig -> created per-az
```
I'm adding one NAT GW per private subnet (per AZ) and switching default route from single NAT instance to gw.

maria: How are you handling the elastic IPs? quota check? :warning:

kevin: Using existing EIP pool, reserving 3. I checked quota with support — OK for now. Plan includes `count = var.az_count`.

anya: For PrivateLink endpoints (RDS + SecretsManager), are you using interface endpoints in the app VPC or a shared services VPC + peering?

kevin: Interface endpoints in the app VPC — simpler for latency. We'll use AWS PrivateLink for RDS Proxy and SecretsManager. Terraform snippet:
```terraform
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "secrets" {
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.us-east-1.secretsmanager"
  vpc_id       = aws_vpc.main.id
  subnet_ids   = aws_subnet.private.*.id
}
```

dave: Make sure security groups allow the endpoint ENIs to talk to your DB SG. Common miss.

sarah: Also confirm route tables for the private subnets reference the new NAT gateways, not the old instance.

kevin: Yup — I updated `aws_route` default route to point to `aws_nat_gateway.*.id` with `for_each` keyed by AZ.

infra-bot: terraform plan completed: 8 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy. (plan id: plan-20260304-3)

maria: Quick perf thought — PrivateLink for S3 is not an option; use gateway endpoint for S3 to avoid interface cost.

kevin: Good catch, switched S3 to gateway endpoint. Terraform now has `aws_vpc_endpoint` type `Gateway` for s3.

anya: Secrets wiring — are you creating SecretsManager resources or referencing existing ARNs? We need IAM role updates for k8s serviceaccount.

kevin: Referencing existing ARNs. I added an IAM role policy binding to the `k8s-secrets-reader` role. Will open a PR to the charts to use IRSA.

dave: Please add `redwood:owner` tags on subnets/nat gateways and include cost-center tag.

kevin: Will add tags + update docs in infra/README. Target deploy window: Thu 02:00 - 04:00 UTC. @maria @sarah can you be on call? :calendar: 

maria: I can do 02:00-03:30 UTC.

sarah: I can join the first hour.

kevin: Thanks — PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/472 (plan attached). Tagging reviewers: @sarah @maria @dave

sarah: Quick nit — in the PR you still have a hardcoded az mapping, please use `data.aws_availability_zones` + `element`.

kevin: Good call, updated. New plan still shows same adds. Will merge after approvals.

maria: LGTM pending infra-bot green. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: apply queued (apply id: apply-20260304-12). Reminder: runbook at infra/runbooks/nat-migration.md

kevin: Thanks all. I'll post a short post-deploy summary here with any rollback steps.

anya: TY!
